text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Gold City really is the best!
Such a powerful run, and her face stays perfect even when she's giving it her all!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Right?!
She can win as the favorite, and she brings flair to the races!
I'd love to see her run tons in the Senior Class too.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...
Ridiculous.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: —City!

Upon returning from the race,
Gold City's manager was waiting with a stern expression.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: "Hey, City. What was that run today?"

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
"I've watched your running all this time, but...
you haven't been beautiful lately."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Huh?
Not beautiful?

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
I'm not talking about results.
This is about you, City.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
Before, you ran with true passion.
Whatever your reasons were...
your races were utterly captivating.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: "That's precisely why I've cooperated with you and watched over your running."

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: "Yet I feel nothing from you right now. ...You're empty."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Empty, huh.
Perhaps so.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
It's true, right now I have...
nothing.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: "Hey, City, why don't you stop now? You've worked hard enough."

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
As an adult, I cannot simply stand by and watch
as you continue to make such an unsightly display of yourself.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: I understand you don't want to be judged on looks alone. But if you keep at it, you will definitely establish your brand as "Gold City."

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
Even if it isn't down this path, you'll be recognized
for who you are someday. That's why...

Gold City was about to catch her breath.
But hearing her manager's words,
I couldn't just stand by and nod in silence...!
choice_data_list: You should keep running for now.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Huh...?
Trainer...?
choice_data_list: If she quits now, I'm sure she'll regret it.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Trainer-san, do you even understand
why City ended up like this
in the first place?

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text: It's because you keep running City without any plan whatsoever.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
You're not respecting City's wishes.
You're just forcing her to run.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
You're trying to push all the blame onto City
and leave a pointless scar on this girl's life.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
If she keeps running like this,
it might leave a lasting trauma.
Is that really what's best for this girl?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Hey Maneji, you're going a bit too far—
choice_data_list: Still, she hasn't said she's 'quitting' yet.

text_block_list.text:
Even with her goal to "change how she's viewed" gone,
even as she laments that there's no meaning in running, she still hasn't given up. If so—
choice_data_list: I'll keep her running until she says it herself

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
That's exactly why...! 
...*sigh*, we're just going around in circles like this.

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
Let's do this. If nothing has changed
by the next race—

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
I will stop you from running, even if I have to use force.
Understood, City?

text_block_list.name: City's Manager
text_block_list.text:
...You can resent me if you want.
Well, see you on set.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...You really are
too intense for me.
choice_data_list: Sorry for doing this without asking.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Don't apologize.
...I know you were looking out for me in your own way, okay?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I'm not a kid, so I know.
Ever since way back, she's always been fussing over me.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Still, that's why...
I can't stay the way I am now."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
They're always thinking about me.
So I can't just go throwing in the towel myself.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"I don't want anyone deciding my future for me.
Not you, not my manager, not anyone..."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I'll think it over properly.
About what I really want to do...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hey, the next race...
is the Tenno Sho (Spring), right?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Until then, I won't be 'empty' anymore.
I'll think about what I'm lacking."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I don't wanna end up resentin' you, or Manager...
or even myself.
